group_assessment.weighting: 🔴 AND THE DIFFERENCE FROM PMID 33058734 IS THE POINT: NO WWOX-PRIMARY LABORATORY IS ON THIS PAPER AT ALL. All seven authors are the same Illinois pulmonary/critical-care division. Aldaz - primary for the gene, and a named author on the 2021 endothelial sequel where he contributed the floxed allele - is ABSENT here. So the corpus's only positive lung-inflammatory result comes from a laboratory that is primary for ARDS and lung barrier biology and had published four WWOX papers total, with no gene-primary co-author to weight the WWOX side of it. That cuts in two directions and both are recorded: the ARDS model, the BALF endpoints and the JNK pharmacology are this group's home ground and are weighted as competent; the WWOX molecular claims (c-Jun sequestration, the SDR/WW domain framing) are imported wholesale from reference 26, which this repository has never read and for which it holds no registry record. Nobody on this paper works on WWOX-related neurodevelopmental disease and the word brain does not occur in the article.

multihop.debt_remaining: 🔴 TEN OF THE FIFTEEN GENE-DIRECT REFERENCES ARE UNREAD HERE, AND ONE OF THEM IS THIS PAPER'S WHOLE MECHANISM. Reference 26, PMID 17178850 (Gaudio 2006, 'Physical association with WWOX suppresses c-Jun transcriptional activity') is the source of the c-Jun sequestration model that every mechanistic sentence of this paper imports, that its Figure 2 sets out to reproduce in A549 cells, and that the JNK rescue depends on - and this repository holds NO registry identity record for it and no receipt, only one incidental mention inside a queue entry. Two more have no identity record either: PMID 16438931 (ezrin-WWOX, reference 34) and PMID 10861292 (the FRA16D sequence paper, reference 55). No queue identifier is minted from this manifest: full_text_queue_current.md is not a surface this dispatch permits me to write, and minting into a shared append-only file I do not own is the peer-race this laboratory has already paid for once. The debt is therefore declared here and carried, with its argument, into CC-20260914-28283473-01 for the orchestrator to address; the five already read are named above so the triage does not have to re-derive them.

entries.proposition: THE IN VIVO MODEL IS ACUTE AIRWAY-DELIVERED siRNA, NOT A GENETIC KNOCKOUT AND NOT WHOLE-BODY. Anaesthesia, tracheal cannulation and intratracheal instillation of 10 mg/kg siRNA in saline into 6-8 week old male C57BL/6 mice. This is the single most consequential fact for FT-178: the corpus has described this paper as a whole-body/global knockdown model, and the delivery is intratracheal into the airway of a wild-type mouse.
entries.snippet: Six- to eight-week-old male C57BL/6 mice were anesthetized with isoflurane and underwent tracheal cannulation. Ten milligrams per kilograms of scrambled control vs. WWOX-silencing RNA were instilled into the airway in saline.
entries.anchor: MATERIALS AND METHODS, 'A murine model of LPS induced neutrophilic alveolitis and silencing of lung WWOX expression'

entries.proposition: ONE siRNA SEQUENCE, ONE SCRAMBLED CONTROL, BOTH PRINTED. The reagent is a single duplex; the control is a scrambled sequence, not a non-silencing validated pool, and no second independent WWOX siRNA is used in vivo.
entries.snippet: The WWOX siRNA sequence was 5′-CCACAGAUUUACAGAUAUU-3′, and the scrambled control sequence was 5′-AUGUAUUGGCCUGUAUUAG-3′.
entries.anchor: MATERIALS AND METHODS, same subsection, the two printed sequences

entries.proposition: THE METHODS STATE 54 HOURS BETWEEN siRNA AND LPS. Recorded as the fixed point for the caption that states a different interval.
entries.snippet: The mice were housed in cages as described above for 54 h after which they underwent reanesthetization and tracheal cannulation for instillation of 1 mg/kg LPS vs.
entries.anchor: MATERIALS AND METHODS, murine model subsection

entries.proposition: THE FIGURE 1 CAPTION STATES SEVENTY-TWO HOURS FOR THE SAME INTERVAL. Methods say 54 h, the caption says 72 h, for the identical step of the identical experiment. Neither is marked as a correction and the article prints both. A reader cannot reconstruct the protocol timing from this paper.
entries.snippet: Seventy-two hours later 3 mice in each group received 40 μl of PBS via intratracheal instillation, and the remaining mice received 1 mg/kg LPS in a 40-μl volume.
entries.anchor: Figure 1 caption

entries.proposition: THE WHOLE IN VIVO EXPERIMENT IS TWELVE MICE, SIX PER siRNA ARM. This is the denominator behind the corpus's entire positive inflammatory leg.
entries.snippet: Twelve C57Bl/6 mice were treated with intratracheal instillation of either control nontargeting (n = 6) or WWOX-targeting siRNA (n = 6).
entries.anchor: Figure 1 caption, opening sentences

entries.proposition: AND THE FOUR GROUPS ARE THEREFORE THREE MICE EACH, WHILE THE CAPTION CALLS IT 'n = 3 independent experiments'. Twelve mice split 6/6 and then 3/3 to PBS or LPS gives n = 3 per group within ONE animal experiment; 'independent experiments' asserts replication the design as described does not contain. The statistics are a two-way ANOVA followed by t-tests on all significant comparisons.
entries.snippet: Results are shown as means ± SD in n = 3 independent experiments. A two-way ANOVA for PBS vs. LPS and control vs. WWOX siRNA was performed followed by a Student’s t-test for all significant comparisons. *P < 0.05, significantly different from control except for comparisons indicated by brackets.
entries.anchor: Figure 1 caption, closing sentences

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE PROPOSITION FT-178 RESTS ON, MEASURED AND FOUND: WWOX SILENCING ALONE - NO LPS, NO SECOND HIT - CAUSED NEUTROPHIL INFLUX AND VASCULAR LEAK TO A DEGREE SIMILAR TO LPS ITSELF. The authors call it surprising. This is a positive, stimulus-free inflammatory phenotype from lung WWOX loss, and it is the mirror image of its 2021 endothelial sequel's twenty-four unstarred bars.
entries.snippet: Surprisingly, WWOX silencing alone caused neutrophil influx (Fig. 1, B–D) and a corresponding vascular leak (Fig. 1, E and F) to a similar degree that LPS did in wild-type mice pretreated with scrambled control siRNA.
entries.anchor: RESULTS, 'Global loss of murine lung WWOX expression causes neutrophilic alveolitis'

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE PANELS CARRY THE ASTERISK ON THE UNSTIMULATED KNOCKDOWN ARM, ON ALL EIGHT QUANTITATIVE PANELS. Inspected at native resolution: in every one of C-J the WWOX-siRNA + PBS group (knockdown, NO LPS) is starred against control. That is the decisive difference from the 2021 endothelial sequel, where the same class of readout carries no asterisk on any of twenty-four bars. Three data points are visible per group, confirming n = 3 animals rather than three experiments.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 1, ten panels. A: WWOX and actin Western blot, four lanes (control siRNA PBS/LPS, WWOX siRNA PBS/LPS). B: haematoxylin-eosin histology, 2x2. C: 'BALF leukocyte count/ml x 10^5' - control+PBS ~3.5 unstarred; control+LPS ~28*; WWOX+PBS ~24*; WWOX+LPS ~30*, with brackets. D: 'BALF neutrophil count/ml x 10^5' - control+PBS ~0.5 unstarred; the other three starred. E: 'BALF total protein ng/ml'. F: 'BALF:Serum FITC-Dextran'. G: 'BALF IL-6 pg/ml'. H: 'BALF IL-1b pg/ml'. I: 'BALF KC pg/ml'. J: 'BALF MIP-2 pg/ml'. In C-J the WWOX-siRNA + PBS point carries an asterisk. Three points per group throughout.
entries.anchor: Figure 1, PMC figure asset inspected as an image at native resolution (639x1203, 300 dpi)

entries.proposition: THE CYTOKINE ARM IS MEASURED AS BALF PROTEIN CONCENTRATIONS BY ELISA AND FOUND ELEVATED: KC AND MIP-2, THE MOUSE IL-8 ANALOGUES, PLUS IL-1beta AND IL-6. So FT-178's third question - counts, cytokine, or histology - is answered 'all three'.
entries.snippet: the levels of both KC and MIP-2 were significantly elevated in the BALF of WWOX-silenced mice as were those of IL-1β and IL-6.
entries.anchor: RESULTS, first subsection, closing sentences

entries.proposition: THE FIGURE 1 CAPTION ENUMERATES THE CYTOKINE PANELS IN THE ORDER IL-1, IL-6, KC, MIP-2 FOR G-J. Recorded as the fixed point for the panel reading that follows.
entries.snippet: C–J: scatter plots depict BAL leukocyte counts, neutrophil counts, protein concentration, and FITC-dextran flux as a measure of permeability, and IL-1, IL-6, keratinocyte-derived chemokine (KC), and macrophage inhibitory-2 (MIP-2) concentrations, respectively.
entries.anchor: Figure 1 caption, the C-J enumeration

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE PANELS PRINT IL-6 AT G AND IL-1b AT H - THE CAPTION'S ORDER IS REVERSED AGAINST ITS OWN FIGURE. Read off the axis labels at native resolution: G is 'BALF IL-6 pg/ml' and H is 'BALF IL-1b pg/ml', while the caption says the respective order is IL-1, IL-6. A reader citing 'Figure 1G' for IL-1 from the caption would cite the IL-6 panel. The drawn axis is the author's own label and adjudicates.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 1 panel G axis reads 'BALF IL-6 pg/ml'; panel H axis reads 'BALF IL-1b pg/ml'; panel I 'BALF KC pg/ml'; panel J 'BALF MIP-2 pg/ml'.
entries.anchor: Figure 1, panels G-J, axis labels at native resolution
entries.contradicts_needle: IL-1, IL-6, keratinocyte-derived chemokine (KC), and macrophage inhibitory-2 (MIP-2) concentrations, respectively

entries.proposition: THE STATISTICAL APPARATUS, QUOTED IN FULL: t-test or ANOVA 'where applicable', GraphPad Prism, significance at P < 0.05. No multiplicity correction is named anywhere in the paper for the eight BALF endpoints of Figure 1.
entries.snippet: Either a Student’s t-test or an ANOVA were performed where applicable on all data using GraphPad Prism software. Significance was set at *P < 0.05.
entries.anchor: MATERIALS AND METHODS, 'Statistical analysis'

entries.proposition: THE NEUTROPHIL READOUT IS A MANUAL DIFFERENTIAL OVER TEN HIGH-POWER FIELDS, NOT AN AUTOMATED DIFFERENTIAL. The absolute leukocyte concentration is machine-counted and the neutrophil PERCENTAGE is read by eye; the paper does not state that the reader was blinded to group.
entries.snippet: A manual differential cell count was performed on 10 high-power fields to determine relative percentages of neutrophils in the leukocyte population.
entries.anchor: MATERIALS AND METHODS, 'BALF collection and analysis'

entries.proposition: THE DISCUSSION CITES 'Fig. 1, D and F' FOR VASCULAR LEAK. Recorded as the fixed point for the panel reading that follows.
entries.snippet: As shown in Fig. 1, D and F, the degree of LPS-induced pulmonary vascular leak observed during WWOX knockdown was significantly greater than that observed in wild-type mice and well out of proportion to the corresponding degree of neutrophilic inflammation seen in these two groups of mice.
entries.anchor: DISCUSSION, the vascular-barrier paragraph

entries.proposition: 🔴 PANEL D IS THE NEUTROPHIL COUNT, NOT A LEAK MEASURE - THE DISCUSSION MISCITES ITS OWN FIGURE WHILE MAKING A CLAIM ABOUT LEAK BEING OUT OF PROPORTION TO INFLAMMATION. The leak panels are E (BALF total protein) and F (BALF:Serum FITC-Dextran); the Results section cites 'Fig. 1, E and F' for exactly this quantity. So the paper's own two statements about which panels show leak disagree, and the Discussion's version points at the inflammation panel it is contrasting leak WITH.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 1 panel D axis reads 'BALF neutrophil count/ml x 10^5'; panel E reads 'BALF total protein ng/ml'; panel F reads 'BALF:Serum FITC-Dextran'.
entries.anchor: Figure 1, panels D, E and F, axis labels at native resolution

entries.proposition: THE AUTHORS' OWN FIRST LIMITATION: ONE siRNA, AND OFF-TARGET EFFECTS EXPLICITLY NOT EXCLUDED FOR THE LUNG NEUTROPHIL INFLUX. The corpus's positive inflammatory leg therefore rests on a single unreplicated reagent by the paper's own admission.
entries.snippet: only one WWOX-targeting siRNA was used in the mouse studies, raising the possibility that off-target effects might be responsible for the observed increase in lung neutrophil influx.
entries.anchor: DISCUSSION, 'There are a few minor limitations to this study'

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE COMPARTMENT ANSWER FT-178 ASKED FOR, IN THE AUTHORS' OWN WORDS: THE PREDOMINANT CELL TYPE HIT BY INTRATRACHEAL siRNA IS THE ALVEOLAR EPITHELIAL CELL. This model is epithelium-weighted, imported from a GFP-siRNA study (reference 52) rather than measured here. It is therefore NOT the endothelial compartment that the 2021 sequel deletes, and the two papers do not address the same cell type - which is the precise reason the endothelial negative does not contradict this positive.
entries.snippet: the predominant cell type affected by intratracheal siRNA delivery is the alveolar epithelial cell (52).
entries.anchor: DISCUSSION, limitations paragraph, the intratracheal-delivery sentence

entries.proposition: AND THE AUTHORS CALL THEIR OWN MODEL 'ACUTE, GLOBAL KNOCKDOWN OF LUNG WWOX EXPRESSION' AND SAY IT REDUCES CLINICAL TRANSLATION. 'Global' here is global WITHIN THE LUNG - across lung cell types, by airway delivery - and the sentence is a limitation, not a boast. The corpus's phrase 'whole-body/global knockdown' takes the authors' word 'global' and attaches it to an organism-level scope the paper never claims.
entries.snippet: The clinical translation of our findings may be reduced by the fact that, in our disease model, we studied acute, global knockdown of lung WWOX expression.
entries.anchor: DISCUSSION, final paragraph

entries.proposition: THE JNK INHIBITOR IS SPELLED 'SP100625' IN THE REAGENTS LIST. Recorded as one of three spellings of one compound.
entries.snippet: FITC-dextran, SP100625, A549 cells, LPS, red blood cell (RBC) lysis buffer, RIPA buffer, and anti-DDK M2 magnetic beads were also from Sigma-Aldrich.

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE FIGURE AXIS PRINTS 'SP600125' - SO ONE COMPOUND IS NAMED THREE WAYS IN ONE PAPER AND THE DRAWN GLYPH SETTLES IT. Reagents say SP100625, the Figure 5 caption says SP500125, the Results text and the figure's own x-axis say SP600125. Only the last is a real JNK inhibitor. This matters beyond pedantry: the 2021 endothelial sequel tested 'SP600125' and found it NOT rescuing in endothelium, so the corpus is comparing two papers' JNK arms across a compound whose identity one of them spells inconsistently.

entries.proposition: 🔴 ATTENUATED IS NOT NORMALISED, AND THE PANEL SHOWS THE RESIDUAL. Figure 5A: WWOX siRNA + DMSO sits ~60 and WWOX siRNA + SP600125 ~47 on the same axis, while BOTH control-siRNA arms sit ~5-8. So JNK inhibition removes a minority of the excess and the knockdown arm remains several-fold above control. The word 'attenuated' is accurate and the magnitude is not in the text.

entries.proposition: 🔴 FIGURE 3E AND 3F ARE SECRETED IL-6 AND IL-8, NOT TRANSMIGRATION - THE RUNNING TEXT'S PANEL LETTERS FOR FIGURE 3 ARE SHIFTED, AND THE PUBLISHED CAPTION IS THE ONE THAT IS RIGHT. The caption assigns B-C to the chemotaxis image and scatter and D-F to IL-1beta, IL-6 and IL-8, which is exactly what the panels show. The text cites B-D for the cytokines and E-F for the transmigration, so in a single paragraph the same panels are cited two incompatible ways.

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE PANELS SHOW THE CYTOKINES HIGHER IN THE SILENCED CELLS, SO THE SENTENCE'S LITERAL DIRECTION IS INVERTED. Every one of Figure 3D-F puts the WWOX-silenced group above control with an asterisk. The intended meaning is obvious and the sentence as printed says the opposite; recorded because a quote-mining consumer would carry the inversion.

entries.proposition: THE MECHANISM ARM IS ENTIRELY IN A549 CELLS AND IS READ AS PIXELS HERE: WWOX CO-IMMUNOPRECIPITATES c-Jun AND ITS SILENCING MOVES c-Jun TO THE NUCLEUS. Quantified as percent of cells with strong nuclear staining over ten high-power fields, n = 3. This is the one arm of the paper with a mechanism, and it is a transformed human alveolar epithelial line, not mouse lung.

entries.proposition: THE HYPOTHESIS THE PAPER SET OUT TO TEST WAS ABOUT ARDS PATHOBIOLOGY VIA WWOX BINDING PARTNERS, AND THE INFLAMMATORY PHENOTYPE WAS NOT THE PREDICTION. It is framed as 'global lung silencing' from the outset.

entries.proposition: THE LEAK/INFLAMMATION DISPROPORTION IS THE PAPER'S OWN UNEXPLORED FINDING, AND IT IS THE ONE THING THAT POINTS AT THE ENDOTHELIUM. Stated as suggesting an influence of WWOX deficiency on endothelial barrier dysfunction during LPS-TLR4 signalling - an inference from disproportion, with no endothelial measurement in this paper.
